why_required: Closest realistic version of the fixed-x typing path, but with complete-keypress/input semantics and human-like gaps.
minimum_event_examples: short word bursts; paragraph continuation; idle-then-type; mixed short and long inter-key gaps
required_assertions: text delta, caret position, undo level, EventDispatch/source spans, visual endpoint
first_valid_claim: synthetic source attribution, recorded validation for product ranking

why_required: Exercises RichText deletion, selection/caret recovery, undo grouping, and different selector invalidations from pure insertion.
minimum_event_examples: single backspace; selected-text replacement; word correction; undo/redo around correction
required_assertions: text hash, selection/caret before/after, undo level, source spans, visual endpoint
first_valid_claim: covered-stratum patch acceptance after behavior gates

why_required: Selector-guard and BlockListItems risks include selection, visibility, focus, and caret state.
minimum_event_examples: arrow navigation; mouse click between blocks; select all in paragraph; block boundary navigation
required_assertions: selected block ids, caret/focus, visible block list, appender state, source spans
first_valid_claim: covered-stratum patch acceptance after behavior gates

why_required: Real editing often enters through paste/transform paths with structural deltas and resource side effects.
minimum_event_examples: plain-text paste; rich paste; transform paragraph to heading/list; multi-block paste
required_assertions: serialized block-tree hash, inserted/transformed block ids, selection recovery, resource markers
first_valid_claim: synthetic first, recorded before product ranking

why_required: High-fanout block-list selectors can be correct for text but stale for structure, appender, template lock, or visibility.
minimum_event_examples: insert block; remove block; drag/reorder; nested block insertion; template-locked edit attempt
required_assertions: block-tree hash, appender visibility, template lock/editing mode, selected block recovery
first_valid_claim: synthetic behavior gate before broad selector claims

why_required: Composition changes event ordering and text deltas; ordinary keypress replay cannot stand in for it.
minimum_event_examples: compositionstart/update/end; multi-character input; replacement during composition
required_assertions: composition boundaries, inputType, text delta, caret state, source spans

why_required: Startup-wait and CPU/QoS results show idle/system state changes first-input and repeated-key behavior.
minimum_event_examples: idle after editing; autosave pending; return to existing draft; first key after long idle
required_assertions: session age, idle gap, autosave/REST markers, pending async markers, first-three-event distribution
first_valid_claim: recorded or long synthetic session before product claim

why_required: Pattern waits, preview canvases, media/resource work, and render endpoints have different readiness and measurement boundaries.
minimum_event_examples: insert pattern; transform pattern; edit media caption; pattern preview interaction
required_assertions: resource markers, preview/render endpoint, block-tree hash, visible result, source spans
first_valid_claim: synthetic first, CI/container validation before wait or product claims

why_required: The original report context mentioned non-vanilla lag; external subscribers, REST work, and plugin UI can dominate owner rankings.
minimum_event_examples: plugin sidebar update; mention/autocomplete; collaborative or P2-like input; external data-store side effect
required_assertions: plugin/theme set, network/resource markers, external-store owner spans, visible plugin state
first_valid_claim: recorded plugin pilot required for product ranking
